flows: R-CNN: region proposals -> warped regions -> CNN features -> class-specific SVMs -> non-maximum suppression
Fast R-CNN: image plus proposals -> shared conv feature map -> RoI pooling -> softmax and bounding-box regression
Faster R-CNN: shared feature map -> RPN anchors -> proposals -> Fast R-CNN detector
Mask R-CNN: Faster R-CNN two-stage detector -> class, box, and mask outputs
Cascade R-CNN: proposals -> repeated detector stages -> progressively refined higher-IoU boxes
gaps: The R-CNN pages give architectural summaries but not benchmark tables or detailed quantitative comparisons.
The artifact intentionally stays within the R-CNN family and does not cover RetinaNet, DETR, or later detector alternatives in depth.
Some wiki captions are brief or generic, so figure explanations are tied back to the page text and verified image content.
